spans.s:
Nāṇappa
Piṣāroṭi of Kerala, contemporary of Uddaṇḍa Śāstrin according to tradition. (‘pratyAhAragrahe'p. bhramitamatirasau ko'p. sAhityavidyAkANo nANappanAmA pralapatu jarasA tAvatA me na hAniH’).
See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 77.

Nāṇāitta
Jain. Jesalmere p. 38. Peters. I. App. p. 48 (no. 74 (10)).
See Nānācittaprakaraṇa.
